about.heading: A house built on trust, scaled by reputation.
about.intro: Two decades in overseas recruitment, officially registered as Mughal House Manpower Consultancy (MH Recruiter) in 2023. From Pandua, West Bengal we have placed 10,000+ skilled workers into Malaysian plantation, construction, manufacturing and hospitality. Both founders sign every contract personally — no call centre, no intermediary.

licensed.title: Government-licensed agency
licensed.description: Registered with the Government of India, license RAS838225. Compliant with all Malaysian recruitment regulations.

predeparture.title: Full pre-departure support
predeparture.description: Medical examinations, documentation, e-visa processing and pre-departure orientation handled in-house.

attention.title: Individual placement attention
attention.description: Each candidate is matched to a role on skill, language and aptitude — never on volume.

zeroFee.title: Zero-fee worker policy
zeroFee.description: Workers pay nothing to us. Costs are borne by the employer, with transparent written contracts on both sides.

services.heading: Eleven sectors. One process. End to end.
services.intro: We source, screen, prepare and deploy workers across eleven industries in Malaysia. Bespoke recruitment briefs are welcome — we routinely build cohorts tailored to specific factories, contracts or project timelines.

process.heading: Six steps from interview to boarding pass.
process.intro: From medical screening in West Bengal to the flight to Kuala Lumpur, we own the full deployment pipeline. Employers and workers face zero paperwork on either side.

medical.title: Medical examination
medical.description: Comprehensive pre-departure health screening at accredited clinics. Fit-to-work certification for the destination country.

clearance.title: Manpower clearance
clearance.description: End-to-end processing of regulatory approvals and government clearances required for legal overseas deployment.

visa.title: E-visa processing
visa.description: Embassy coordination and visa application managed by our in-house documentation team.

ticketing.title: Air ticketing
ticketing.description: Flight bookings and group travel coordination from India to Malaysia, sequenced with contract start dates.

passport.title: Passport & documentation
passport.description: Passport applications, renewals, contract attestation and supporting paperwork handled on the candidate's behalf.

orientation.title: Pre-departure orientation
orientation.description: Briefings on Malaysian labour law, workplace rights, cultural norms and emergency protocols before travel.

testimonials.heading: Words from the people behind the promise.
testimonials.intro: Both partners are directly involved in every deployment — from sourcing workers in West Bengal to final placement in Malaysia.

manivanna.name: Manivanna
manivanna.title: Malaysia Business Partner
manivanna.quote: On the Malaysia side, my job is to make sure every worker Mughal House sends arrives to an employer who is ready, a workplace that is legal, and a contract that holds. I have walked through factories, plantations and construction sites across the country to vet every employer we place workers with. That ground-level diligence is what keeps the trust on both sides of the corridor.
manivanna.highlight: Vets every Malaysian employer on the ground

hemraj.name: Hemraj Dahal
hemraj.title: Director & Partner
hemraj.quote: Building trust with Malaysian employers takes years of consistent delivery. Every employer we work with knows that when Mughal House sends a worker, that worker is prepared — medically cleared, legally documented, culturally oriented, and ready to contribute on day one. We have built this reputation through zero compromise on quality and full transparency at every step.

firoz.name: Firoz Ahamed
firoz.title: Managing Director
firoz.quote: Every worker who walks through our office door in Pandua arrives with a dream — a better life for their family. Our job is to make that dream real, safely and legally. From the first document to the flight boarding pass, we handle it all. The families who send their sons and daughters through us trust us completely, and that trust is something we guard with everything we have.
firoz.highlight: Zero-fee policy for every worker we place

team.heading: The people behind every successful deployment.
team.intro: A structured team of recruitment specialists, documentation officers and field managers — each one accountable for every worker and employer we serve. Click any card to view a full profile.

sAhamed.title: Chairman & Founder
sAhamed.blurb: Founder of Mughal House, S. Ahamed (Raju) has personally overseen the deployment of over 10,000 workers from West Bengal to Malaysia. His vision of ethical, transparent recruitment drives every placement the company makes.

hemraj.title: Business Development & Overseas Director
hemraj.blurb: Hemraj Dahal leads employer partnerships and overseas business development, expanding Mughal House's reach across Malaysian manufacturing, plantation, construction and hospitality sectors.

firoz.title: Director (India)
firoz.blurb: Firoz Ahamed manages the day-to-day operations of Mughal House in India — from candidate intake at the Pandua office to final deployment confirmation. His meticulous approach ensures every placement runs without a hitch.

manivanna.title: Malaysia Business Partner
manivanna.blurb: Manivanna leads Mughal House's Malaysia-side operations from Kuala Lumpur — vetting employers, negotiating contracts and making sure every worker we deploy arrives to a legal, prepared workplace. His on-ground presence is the link between West Bengal and the Malaysian floor.

rabiul.title: Documentation & Visa Processing Officer
rabiul.blurb: Md. Rabiul Hussain leads documentation and e-visa processing at Mughal House — from passport and contract paperwork to embassy coordination — making sure every worker's travel file is complete and on time.

arif.title: Accountant
arif.blurb: Arif supports the finance team at Mughal House, working alongside Md. Rabiul Hussain on day-to-day bookkeeping, payment records and employer billing so every transaction stays accurate and on time.

manik.title: Marketing Manager, India
manik.blurb: Manik Sekh drives candidate outreach and brand awareness across West Bengal — connecting communities in Hooghly and surrounding districts with legitimate overseas employment opportunities.

abdul.title: Public Relations Officer
abdul.blurb: Abdul Mabud Dhabak manages public relations and stakeholder communication — building trust with local communities, government bodies and partner organisations on behalf of Mughal House.

sowel.title: Front Desk Officer
sowel.blurb: Sowel Rana Mondal is the first face every visitor meets at Mughal House — welcoming candidates and partners, coordinating appointments, and keeping the front-desk operations running smoothly day to day.
